captions.detailed: A floor-standing candy vending machine with a tall red rectangular cabinet and a glazed front door. The front door is framed in red with a semi-transparent blue glass pane and a white vertical handle, designed to pivot on a side hinge. Inside the cabinet are three shelves holding spiral product dispensers, while the bottom section features a white-framed product retrieval chute with a dark flap and a black selector knob on the right.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a floor-standing candy vending machine with a tall red cabinet, a front glass door that pivots on a side hinge, internal spiral shelves, a lower retrieval chute with a hinged flap, and a rotating selector knob on the bottom right.
captions.factory: The object is constructed using an ArticulatedObject builder. The main cabinet is modeled as a hollowed Box primitive with red and black materials. The front door is built with a red frame, a translucent blue central glass panel, and a white handle, attached to the cabinet via a vertical revolute joint. Internal shelves are placed at regular vertical intervals, each populated with spiral product coils modeled using helix-like geometry. The lower retrieval chute flap is defined as a thin box attached via a horizontal revolute joint, and the selector knob is modeled as a cylinder attached via a continuous rotational joint.
